steps.name: Queue
steps.what: Several issues wait in front of Pick up. Every agent is at rest. Nothing is on the line yet.

steps.name: Pick up
steps.what: The Pick up agent lifts the first issue out of the queue and onto the line. The item is an issue.

steps.name: Build and open
steps.what: The pull request appears. The Open agent acts. The item is the issue with its pull request.

steps.name: Drive
steps.what: The Drive agent inspects the pull request. The item shows comments and build status, some pending and one failed. A question waits on the person's desk.

steps.name: Repair, then green
steps.what: The Repair agent acts on the failed check. Every check is green.

steps.name: Merge
steps.what: A person merges. The item is merged.

steps.name: Follow up
steps.what: A small new issue travels the short side feed back to the queue's tail. The merged item rests at the end of the line.

steps.name: Capacity
steps.what: The dispatcher reads Memory, Processor, Disk and Forge budget as gauges. The Usage limit is a wall, and work waits in front of it.

prompt.intro: Each candidate was asked to draw one work item travelling through Jig's line of seven stations, as stills in jig-harness.dev's plate style: ink on paper, hatching, one green accent. Stations are moving agents (robotic arms or other machines with a tool fitted to the job); the item changes form from an issue to a merged pull request; a person is a person, shown where a question waits and where they merge. This is a design round, not a build.
fixed: The line is not a loop. Follow up reaches Pick up as a short side feed.
The pickup queue is drawn. A person merges; agents never do.
The item is never a plain box, and each of its five forms reads in greyscale.
Green is only for a person's moments and for checks turning green. Agents are ink, paper and grey.
Capacity shows no numbers and no mention of more than one account. Only the wall stops work.
Colours are the site's tokens, so light and dark both work. Text is a fixed list of words in the system sans stack.
Each agent is drawn in three still poses: rest, reach, act.
prompt.words: Words in the drawings: Queue, Pick up, Build, Open, Drive, Repair, Merge, Follow up, Dispatcher, Question, Issue, Pull request, Comments, Checks, Merged, Memory, Processor, Disk, Forge budget, Usage limit.
